device: NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, driver 580.105.08, CUDA 12.8; host Intel Xeon Platinum 8480+ (KVM guest), transparent huge pages = madvise
units: median microseconds per copy (200 repetitions up to 2 MiB, 12 above); the huge-page columns advise only whole 2 MiB pages, so below 4 MiB they measure the same work as the columns without advice
note: Each repetition copies into one freshly allocated vector, which glibc maps anew at 32 MiB and above, so every page faults. to_host fills three smaller vectors that the allocator often reuses; end to end on the H100, staging beat direct copies into huge-page-advised vectors at every size (cuda_h100_direct_above_16mib.json).
